title: [3.1.0.3-dev-a_a995867cda] Report of 2 bugs - One left
symptom: In the latest dev versions, two bugs: deleting wrong entries in Treatments is not possible (Delete button and 'Remove AAPS started entrys' have no function), and messages that appear when entering wrong values (basal, ISF) show only a white box with white letters on white background.
fix: The menu (treatment deletion) was fixed by a commit. The white letters issue was still remaining in Profile (Basal and IC) at the time of the last comment, and it was noted that these specific and some others were replaced.
